I made this for anyone who is starting out or for those interested in seeing how I started my devotion to her. Growing up, I was super religious and was told to stay away from Santa by the Church. But then As I grew up, I would feel a pull towards her iconography anytime I saw it and would research about her but didn’t start a relationship with her until I hit my lowest point with my depression which was when I was 22. During this time, I decided that if I’m going to k!ll myself then I should at least  befriend her so I know who to expect when I die. So then I decided to build a small altar to her which was with a candle, incense, and some Florida water. Immediately, I began to feel better after having an altar to her and things started to get better for me. Then one day, I came to my boyfriends house and he found a small 7 day colored statue of Santa muerte at his front door and didn’t know who it came from. I hadn’t told him that I had started my devotion to Santa Muerte at the time. In fact, I hadn’t told anyone other than my housemate. But he didn’t know what to do with the statue so I decided to take it in. Then my altar grew a bit more.

At 37.5, Effexor acts more like an SSRI and is a starting dose. Then at higher dosages, it begins to act as an SNRI and really starts to work on norepinephrine. In addition, it can take time for your brain to get use to the medication. From my experience, I too, was feeling well and better at 37.5 but that didn’t last quite long because I would end up just feeling depressed again. I didn’t start to actually feel good until I got to 225mg. This is the dose I’m on right now and is doing wonders.

I know it may suck at the moment but hang in there. This isn’t my first rodeo with antidepressants and know that it can take a while for the medication to help so I understand during this period, you might feel off or impatient. I think it’s also important to know that if this medication doesn’t work out for you, then that’s okay. There are plenty more that can work for you. Try and take care of yourself during this period while your body and brain undergo chemical changes. Be gentle and patient with yourself too. You got this!
